messages:
Laura (Finance): FYI — Clearview just flagged their March invoice: missing reserved GPU line and there's a -$120 phantom refund that shouldn't exist. Support forwarded the customer email.
Matt (Billing): ugh, on it. Ticket? link?
Emma (Support): https://app.prod.redwood/finance/tickets/INC-4921 — customer attached PDFs, says invoice id INV-2026-03-9876 was emailed twice and one copy has a refund line.
Sasha (Billing): I see two invoices for the same billing period in the DB: INV-2026-03-9876 and INV-2026-03-9876-1. The second has refund lines from proration. Probably a race during the nightly invoice run.
Oliver (Recon): quick check: ran the usage export for cust_clearview for 2026-03, looks normal. No negative consumption. Query I used:

```
SELECT * FROM usage_events WHERE customer_id='cust_clearview' AND period='2026-03' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50;
```

Zero negative rows.
Matt (Billing): could be a proration job that replayed after a retry and applied an overlap credit. Which job produces the proration lines? `billing-runner/prorate_and_finalize`
Sasha (Billing): yeah, and we had a recent pricing experiment for reserved discounts (experiment id px-resv-3) that touched the proration path last week.
Laura (Finance): important: customer is enterprise tier, we need manual fix and an apology. Also need to ensure we don't double-bill credits.
Emma (Support): customer asked for a corrected PDF and confirmation that they won't be double-charged. They are waiting.
Oliver (Recon): I pulled the invoice_line dump for INV-2026-03-9876-1:

```
line_id,line_type,amount,meta
l_9876_1,usage,450.00,"gpu-hours: 120"
l_9876_2,proration,-120.00,"overlap_claim: true, source_run: billing-runner-2026-03-01-03:00"
```

The proration line references a source_run that shouldn't have executed twice.
Matt (Billing): possible causes: 1) scheduler retried the job while previous run still finalizing, 2) idempotency key missing on finalize step. I'll check scheduler logs.
BillingBot: SCHEDULE: billing-runner/prorate_and_finalize started 2026-03-01T03:00:12Z (run_id br-20260301-03-00)\nSCHEDULE: billing-runner/prorate_and_finalize started 2026-03-01T03:00:58Z (run_id br-20260301-03-00-retry)
Sasha (Billing): that bot log confirms a retry with same run id. Looks like the retry didn't short-circuit and produced a second invoice delta.
Laura (Finance): action items: manual reversal of the phantom -$120 credit on the duplicate invoice, consolidate duplicates into single invoice PDF, patch billing-runner finalize to be idempotent, and postmortem. Who owns each?
Matt (Billing): I'll do the idempotency patch today. Will open a PR and link here.
Sasha (Billing): I'll handle the manual invoice consolidation + credit reversal. Will draft the corrected PDF and push to billing queue. ETA 2 hours.
Oliver (Recon): I'll add a reconciliation check to detect duplicate invoice ids produced within 1 hour of each other and alert. Quick lint in recon job.
Emma (Support): I'll send customer a heads-up note: "we're investigating, corrected invoice ETA ~2-3 hours" and include ticket INC-4921.
Laura (Finance): thanks. Sasha — please include the experiment id px-resv-3 in the postmortem and any signal that linking the experiment to the retry.
Sasha (Billing): will do. PR for the fix: https://repo.redwood/billing/pulls/1428
Matt (Billing): patch merged to staging. scheduling test to reproduce retry scenario now.
BillingBot: JOB: manual-reissue queued for INV-2026-03-9876 (operator Sasha)\nJOB: notify-customer queued for INC-4921 (operator Emma)
Emma (Support): sent update to customer. they replied: "Thanks, please confirm once corrected invoice is sent." :thumbsup:
Laura (Finance): keep thread updated. we'll include this in weekly billing incidents. assign postmortem owner after fix.
Sasha (Billing): will follow up with a short postmortem and remediation checklist once consolidation is done.
